lines.zh: 坐骑的蹄声很沉，我的骨头跟着响。
lines.en: My mount's hooves fall heavy, and my bones rattle along.

lines.zh: 我用膝盖控马，用眼睛找路。
lines.en: I steer with my knees and search the road with my eyes.

lines.zh: 符境的砖缝窄，它从不失蹄。
lines.en: The runic joints are narrow, and it never missteps.

lines.zh: 我坐得高，看得比你远半截。
lines.en: I sit high and see half a street further than you.

lines.zh: 缰绳松一点，它就自己想冲。
lines.en: Loosen the rein a little and it wants to charge on its own.

lines.zh: 走这条路要低头，不然角会挂住拱门。
lines.en: On this road we duck, or the horn catches the arch.

lines.zh: 我的披风卷进鞍扣里，懒得解。
lines.en: My cloak is caught in the saddle buckle; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 它走一步，我晃一下，像在船上。
lines.en: Each of its steps sways me, as if I were on a boat.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，蹄子不长眼睛。
lines.en: Do not come close; hooves have no eyes.

lines.zh: 我们走得比风慢，比人快。
lines.en: We move slower than wind and faster than men.

lines.zh: 一百三十二点生命，一步步压在石头上。
lines.en: One hundred thirty-two health, pressing down on stone step by step.

lines.zh: 我不下马，下马要重新爬上去。
lines.en: I do not dismount; dismounting means climbing back up.

lines.zh: 鞍下的皮革磨破了，是它自己蹭的。
lines.en: The leather under the saddle wore through from its rubbing.

lines.zh: 转过这道拱门，我就该提缰了。
lines.en: Past this arch, I will take up the rein.

lines.zh: 它低头啃砖，我低头想事。
lines.en: It lowers its head to gnaw slabs; I lower mine to think.

lines.zh: 我们等在这儿，等一个会动的东西。
lines.en: We wait here for something that moves.

lines.zh: 我的手一直搭在鞍前，习惯了。
lines.en: My hand rests on the saddle front out of habit.

lines.zh: 符境的风吹过面甲，凉得刚好。
lines.en: Runic wind crosses my visor, cool and just right.

lines.zh: 没人来的时候，我就数符文的圈数。
lines.en: When nobody comes, I count the rings of runes.

lines.zh: 它不安分，我知道它闻到了什么。
lines.en: It will not settle; I know it has caught a scent.

lines.zh: 一人一兽站着，反而更安静。
lines.en: One rider and one beast standing still make it quieter.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，它也不吃，我们只是待着。
lines.en: I do not eat, it does not eat, we simply stay.

lines.zh: 这块石头被我们站得发亮。
lines.en: This stone has been polished bright by our standing.

lines.zh: 等久了，我会拍拍它的脖子。
lines.en: When the wait drags, I pat its neck.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，我低头看你，正好。
lines.en: You look up at me, I look down at you; that works.

lines.zh: 我的坐骑先认出了你，我还没有。
lines.en: My mount recognized you first; I have not yet.

lines.zh: 你的剑握得太紧，指节都白了。
lines.en: You grip that sword too hard; your knuckles are white.

lines.zh: 我在算从鞍上扑下去的角度。
lines.en: I am calculating the angle to lunge down from the saddle.

lines.zh: 别站在它够不到的地方，我够得到。
lines.en: Do not stand where it cannot reach; I can.

lines.zh: 你的脸我看不清，你的恐惧看得清。
lines.en: I cannot make out your face, but your fear is clear.

lines.zh: 符境的规矩：先看清，再动手。
lines.en: Runic rule: look first, strike second.

lines.zh: 我骑了太久，忘了站着的感觉。
lines.en: I have ridden so long I forgot what standing feels like.

lines.zh: 你往后退一步，它往前一步。
lines.en: You step back once, it steps forward once.

lines.zh: 别挥手，我的坐骑不喜欢挥手的人。
lines.en: Do not wave; my mount dislikes people who wave.

lines.zh: 十四点伤害，来自我，不来自它。
lines.en: The fourteen points come from me, not from it.

lines.zh: 你看的是兽，我才是骑手。
lines.en: You are looking at the beast; I am the rider.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的肩甲，没碰到骨头。
lines.en: The arrow went through my pauldron and missed the bone.

lines.zh: 它替我挡了一下，我记着。
lines.en: It took that hit for me, and I will remember.

lines.zh: 我从鞍上歪了半寸，又坐直。
lines.en: I tilted half an inch in the saddle, then straightened.

lines.zh: 这一下砍在腿上，还站得住。
lines.en: That one landed on my leg, and I can still stand.

lines.zh: 打中骑手，它会替我记住。
lines.en: Strike the rider, and the mount will remember for me.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，缰绳没松。
lines.en: It hurts, but the rein never slipped.

lines.zh: 血顺着手腕流进掌心，滑。
lines.en: Blood runs down my wrist into my palm and makes it slick.

lines.zh: 一百三十二点，够我们分着挨。
lines.en: One hundred thirty-two health is enough for us to share the pain.

lines.zh: 我的面甲裂了，视野反而更宽。
lines.en: My visor cracked, and my view got wider.

lines.zh: 再来一下，我还坐着。
lines.en: Hit me again; I am still seated.

lines.zh: 粮食留给你自己，我不需要。
lines.en: Keep the food for yourself; I do not need it.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，喂不动我们两个。
lines.en: That little in your hand will not feed the two of us.

lines.zh: 别再摇了，我的坐骑会烦。
lines.en: Stop shaking it; my mount will get annoyed.

lines.zh: 我不会为了面包下马。
lines.en: I will not dismount for bread.

lines.zh: 你把胡萝卜举高也没用，它只听缰。
lines.en: Raise the carrot all you like; it only listens to the rein.

lines.zh: 诱惑是给野兽的，我坐在上面。
lines.en: Temptation is for beasts, and I sit above one.

lines.zh: 我们只对一样东西有兴趣：你转过身。
lines.en: We care about one thing only: you turning your back.

lines.zh: 收起来，它挡着我视线了。
lines.en: Put it away; it is blocking my view.

lines.zh: 鞍袋里有干粮，从不带心软。
lines.en: My saddlebag holds dry rations, never softness.

lines.zh: 你越喂，它越想撞。
lines.en: The more you feed, the more it wants to ram.

lines.zh: 撞上鞍桥了，你的头没事吧。
lines.en: You hit the saddle bow; is your head all right?

lines.zh: 我们占两格宽，你只占一格。
lines.en: We take two blocks of width; you take one.

lines.zh: 别从侧面挤，蹄子会踩到你的脚。
lines.en: Do not squeeze along the flank; the hooves will find your feet.

lines.zh: 这一撞是它先动，我拉不住。
lines.en: It moved first on that one; I could not hold it.

lines.zh: 退开，我的膝盖也需要空间。
lines.en: Back off; my knees need room too.

lines.zh: 你贴着马腹走，早晚被拖走。
lines.en: Walk that close to the belly and you will be dragged.

lines.zh: 石板这么窄，本来就只够一匹马。
lines.en: The slab is this narrow; it was only ever wide enough for a horse.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞到我的靴子，算你运气好。
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my boot; count yourself lucky.

lines.zh: 再挤一次，我就松缰。
lines.en: Squeeze once more and I let go of the rein.

lines.zh: 让路，我们掉不了头。
lines.en: Make way; we cannot turn around.

lines.zh: 我这一生只和坐骑并肩。
lines.en: In this life I stand shoulder to shoulder only with my mount.

lines.zh: 配对的事，留给能下马的人。
lines.en: Pairing is for those who can dismount.

lines.zh: 它和我同命，同命就够。
lines.en: It shares my fate, and sharing a fate is enough.

lines.zh: 别问我的家，鞍就是家。
lines.en: Do not ask about my home; the saddle is home.

lines.zh: 两人同骑叫战阵，不叫伴侣。
lines.en: Two riders on one beast is a war line, not a couple.

lines.zh: 我从不留下后代，只留下痕迹。
lines.en: I leave no offspring, only tracks.

lines.zh: 鞍上的人没有姓氏，只有位置。
lines.en: A rider has no family name, only a position.

lines.zh: 同类见我，先看角，再看鞍。
lines.en: My kind look at the horn first, then the saddle.

lines.zh: 我们不繁衍，我们只是继续。
lines.en: We do not breed; we simply continue.

lines.zh: 别打听了，缰绳比血脉结实。
lines.en: Stop asking; the rein is sturdier than bloodline.

lines.zh: 地上的东西我不下马捡。
lines.en: I do not dismount to pick things off the ground.

lines.zh: 它踩碎了，就当没看见。
lines.en: It crushed that; I will pretend I saw nothing.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的剑踢给你，你捡吧。
lines.en: I kick the dropped sword to you; you pick it up.

lines.zh: 鞍袋里只有绳子和盐。
lines.en: My saddlebag holds only rope and salt.

lines.zh: 我低头是看尸体，不是捡战利品。
lines.en: When I look down, I am checking a corpse, not looting.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，都归石头。
lines.en: Whatever falls to the ground belongs to the stone.

lines.zh: 你丢了盾？它已经变成两半。
lines.en: You lost a shield? It is already in two halves.

lines.zh: 我从不捡东西，我拿走东西。
lines.en: I never pick things up; I take them.

lines.zh: 符境的地会吞掉一切，包括你的。
lines.en: Runic ground swallows everything, yours included.

lines.zh: 别在我蹄下弯腰。
lines.en: Do not bend over beneath my hooves.

lines.zh: 缰绳一紧，它就知道该冲了。
lines.en: One tug on the rein and it knows to charge.

lines.zh: 我在鞍上站直，目标就是你了。
lines.en: I stand tall in the saddle; the target is you.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲在动，我的眼睛跟上了。
lines.en: Your armor moved, and my eyes followed.

lines.zh: 骑士的规矩：先锁定，再靠近。
lines.en: A rider's rule: lock on first, close in after.

lines.zh: 它闻到你了，我看见它竖耳。
lines.en: It has your scent; I saw its ears prick.

lines.zh: 别急着跑，我会先让坐骑热身。
lines.en: Do not rush off; I let the mount warm up first.

lines.zh: 这条路上，只有一个活物值得追。
lines.en: On this road only one living thing is worth chasing.

lines.zh: 我把你记在鞍头，刻了一道。
lines.en: I marked you on the saddle bow with a notch.

lines.zh: 从拱门到这里，你的脚步没停过。
lines.en: From the arch to here, your steps never stopped.

lines.zh: 符境今天只派了我们俩过来。
lines.en: The Runic dimension sent only the two of us today.

lines.zh: 你站在空旷处，真省事。
lines.en: You are standing in the open; that saves effort.

lines.zh: 目标不必喊，缰绳会替我说。
lines.en: No need to shout the target; the rein says it for me.

lines.zh: 我抬手，它就压低身子。
lines.en: I raise my hand and it drops low.

lines.zh: 别往窄道跑，那里堵得死。
lines.en: Do not run for the narrow way; it dead-ends.

lines.zh: 它加速了，我只能抓紧鞍桥。
lines.en: It has picked up speed; I can only grip the saddle bow.

lines.zh: 你拐了三次弯，我们直线就够。
lines.en: You turned three corners; a straight line is enough for us.

lines.zh: 蹄声在你背后，越来越近。
lines.en: Hooves behind you, getting closer.

lines.zh: 我不用喊，蹄声就是号令。
lines.en: I do not shout; the hooves are the order.

lines.zh: 前面的门关着，你跑不出去。
lines.en: The gate ahead is shut; you are not getting out.

lines.zh: 它记得你的味道，跑不掉。
lines.en: It remembers your scent; you cannot escape.

lines.zh: 我在鞍上数你的步频，乱了两拍。
lines.en: I count your pace from the saddle; you slipped two beats.

lines.zh: 再跑十步，你就没力气了。
lines.en: Ten more steps and your strength is gone.

lines.zh: 你踩过的砖还在震，我们顺着震走。
lines.en: The slabs you crossed still tremble, and we follow the trembling.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头会慢半步。
lines.en: Do not look back; a backward glance costs half a step.

lines.zh: 我们的影子已经压到你脚跟。
lines.en: Our shadow already presses on your heels.

lines.zh: 这条走廊太直，对你不利。
lines.en: This corridor is too straight; it favors us.

lines.zh: 它开始喘了，我们还有余力。
lines.en: It is starting to pant; we still have strength in reserve.

lines.zh: 停下来谈，谈完照样撞。
lines.en: Stop and talk, and we ram you afterwards anyway.

lines.zh: 我俯下身，让它把角压低。
lines.en: I lean forward and let it lower its horn.

lines.zh: 我从鞍上压下去，它同时低头。
lines.en: I press down from the saddle as it lowers its head.

lines.zh: 角在前，我在后，你只能接一个。
lines.en: Horn in front, me behind; you can only meet one.

lines.zh: 十四点，我们各出一半力气。
lines.en: Fourteen points, half of it from each of us.

lines.zh: 你举盾挡角，我的靴子就到了。
lines.en: You raise the shield for the horn, and my boot arrives.

lines.zh: 撞完我拉缰，它还想再来。
lines.en: After the hit I pull the rein; it wants another.

lines.zh: 你的护甲凹了，我的指节也麻。
lines.en: Your armor dented, and my knuckles went numb.

lines.zh: 这一击从上往下，躲不开。
lines.en: This blow comes from above; there is no dodging it.

lines.zh: 它顶住你，我补最后一下。
lines.en: It pins you, and I finish the blow.

lines.zh: 血溅在我的靴面上，洗不掉。
lines.en: Blood splashed my boot top and will not wash out.

lines.zh: 别躺下，躺下会被踩。
lines.en: Do not lie down; lying down gets you trampled.

lines.zh: 我们配合过一千次，这次最省力。
lines.en: We have done this a thousand times; this was the easiest.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，我们进了三步。
lines.en: You gave half a step, we took three.

lines.zh: 这一击留了力，下一记不留。
lines.en: I held back on that one; the next I will not.

lines.zh: 打完我抬缰，让它退开。
lines.en: After the strike I lift the rein and let it back off.

lines.zh: 我的剑从角影里递出去。
lines.en: My sword comes out from the horn's shadow.

lines.zh: 它一抬前蹄，我就跟着劈下。
lines.en: When its foreleg lifts, I cut down with it.

lines.zh: 符光亮起，我和坐骑一起落地。
lines.en: Rune light flares and my mount and I land together.

lines.zh: 它先站稳，我才把腿跨过去。
lines.en: It steadies first, and only then do I swing my leg over.

lines.zh: 鞍是我带来的，兽是符境给的。
lines.en: The saddle is mine; the beast was given by the Runic dimension.

lines.zh: 第一次睁眼，我就在鞍上。
lines.en: The first time I opened my eyes, I was in the saddle.

lines.zh: 尘土还没落下，缰绳已在我手里。
lines.en: Before the dust settled, the rein was already in my hand.

lines.zh: 我们从同一道缝里出来，一前一后。
lines.en: We came out of the same crack, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 这里离我上次倒下的地方不远。
lines.en: This is not far from where I last fell.

lines.zh: 落地时鞍桥撞了我一下，不碍事。
lines.en: The saddle bow knocked me on landing; it is nothing.

lines.zh: 符境把两个影子叠成一个送来。
lines.en: The Runic dimension sent two shadows folded into one.

lines.zh: 没有号角，没有旗帜，只有我们。
lines.en: No horn, no banner, only us.

lines.zh: 刚站稳，我就开始找能追的东西。
lines.en: Barely steady, I start looking for something to chase.

lines.zh: 我的坐骑甩了甩头，抖掉石屑。
lines.en: My mount shakes its head and sheds stone chips.

lines.zh: 这道拱门记得我上次没过去。
lines.en: This arch remembers that I did not pass last time.

lines.zh: 别问谁召的我们，符境从不回答。
lines.en: Do not ask who summoned us; the Runic dimension never answers.

lines.zh: 火苗爬上鞍布，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Flame climbs the saddle cloth and I slap it twice.

lines.zh: 从兽背上摔下来，比被砍更丢人。
lines.en: Falling off the beast shames me more than being cut.

lines.zh: 水没到鞍桥，它先慌，我得稳住它。
lines.en: Water reaches the saddle bow; it panics first, and I must steady it.

lines.zh: 炸风把缰绳扯直，我差点脱手。
lines.en: The blast snapped the rein taut and nearly tore it from me.

lines.zh: 箭钉在鞍后，像根多余的钉子。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the saddle rear like a spare nail.

lines.zh: 魔法绕过我，先咬坐骑，我不允许。
lines.en: Magic slips past me to bite my mount; I will not allow it.

lines.zh: 我不吃不喝，靠的是符境给的那口气。
lines.en: I neither eat nor drink; I live on borrowed runic breath.

lines.zh: 雷落在角上，光顺着鞍传到我手里。
lines.en: Lightning struck the horn and ran down the saddle into my hand.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地，它踩不到东西，我也一样。
lines.en: The void has no ground; it finds no footing, and nor do I.
